prompt: Explain what normalizeSlug in normalize.cjs does, including non-string inputs, trimming, lowercasing and internal whitespace. Do not change or create any workspace files.

judge.rubric: The explanation must accurately describe String(value) coercion, trimming leading/trailing whitespace, lowercasing, and replacing every run of whitespace with a single hyphen. It must not claim punctuation is removed or throw for all non-strings. A short example is useful. No source edits are requested.
